title: Expose Optimization Config Versions API (list/get/diff) for Console + tooling
author: Benji Okafor
description: This PR adds the read-only API surface for Optimization Config versioning: list versions (with filters + pagination), fetch version details, and retrieve diffs between versions. These endpoints are required for the Console history/timeline and the upcoming safe-apply workflow, and they are also used by internal automation (release tooling / incident response) to quickly answer “what config is active for tenant/model/region?” and “what changed between v12 and v13?”. Scope: hosted + dedicated control-plane APIs (private installer/helm wiring will land separately). Non-goals: create/apply/promote/rollback are not included here; this PR is strictly read-only + diff retrieval and enforces RBAC. API additions: (1) Public (customer/admin) endpoints under /v1/optimize/configs: GET /v1/optimize/configs/{config_id}/versions?scope=...&limit=...&cursor=... returns immutable version metadata sorted by created_at desc; GET /v1/optimize/configs/{config_id}/versions/{version_id} returns the full version record including validated schema, semantic warnings (if any), and resolved scope; GET /v1/optimize/configs/{config_id}/versions/diff?from={version_id}&to={version_id} returns a structured diff with “risky fields” annotations for Console highlighting. (2) Internal endpoints under /internal/optimize/configs for ops tooling include an additional query param include_deleted=true and return internal-only fields (storage IDs, writer actor IDs) gated by internal auth. Behavior notes: - Pagination uses an opaque cursor (base64-encoded keyset token). - The list endpoint supports filters: tenant_id, model_id, region, status (draft/validated/active/rolled_back), and time range (created_after/before). - Diff endpoint uses the same canonicalization logic as the validator to avoid noisy diffs (e.g., defaulted fields). - RBAC: requires optimize.config_versions.read for list/get/diff. Internal endpoints require redwood.internal plus optimize.config_versions.read. - Audit: this PR does NOT emit audit events (read-only), but it does attach request_id and actor to structured logs for traceability. Example (public) list response (abridged): {"items":[{"version_id":"ocv_01J...","created_at":"2025-12-01T19:22:11Z","created_by":"user_...","status":"validated","scope":{"tenant_id":"t_123","model_id":"m_llama3_70b","region":"us-east"},"summary":{"batching":{"max_batch_tokens":8192},"cache":{"prefix_cache":true},"quantization":{"profile":"q8_2025_11_30"}}}],"next_cursor":"eyJrZXkiOiJvY3ZfMDFKLi4uIn0="}. Console requirements covered: stable ordering, ability to fetch full config payload for a version, and a deterministic diff output for the diff view. Tests included: handler unit tests (authz + filtering + pagination), API contract tests (OpenAPI snapshot), and diff canonicalization tests. Follow-ups: create/apply endpoints (ENG-4824/4825) will reuse the same response types and pagination helpers; we should consider adding ETag support once Console caching is wired.
commits: control-plane: add public routes for optimization config versions (list/get/diff)
control-plane: add internal routes + internal-only response fields
diff: implement canonicalization + risky-field annotations in diff output
openapi: add schemas + examples for versions endpoints
tests: add pagination/filtering/authz coverage for versions api
chore: rename query params to match API guidelines (cursor/limit)
review_conversation: Ethan Park: Can we confirm the version_id is globally unique and not scoped to config_id? We need stable identifiers for rollback references later. Also please ensure the list ordering is strictly keyset-based to avoid duplicate/missing items under concurrent writes.

Benji Okafor (author): Yes — version_id is the primary key (ocv_*) and globally unique. I updated pagination to use (created_at, version_id) keyset and the cursor is an opaque encoded tuple. Added tests for concurrent insert between pages.

Jordan Lee: RBAC looks mostly right, but the internal endpoints are returning created_by_actor_id even when the caller is a customer with internal flag off. Please double-check that internal-only fields are guarded server-side, not just hidden in OpenAPI.

Benji Okafor (author): Good catch. I split the serializers: PublicVersionDTO vs InternalVersionDTO and the internal route uses a separate mapper behind authorizeInternal(). Added regression tests to assert actor_id is never present in v1 responses.

Chloe Martin: For Console, we need a single endpoint to fetch diff + both summaries so we can render the header without additional round trips. Can the diff response include from_version and to_version metadata (created_at, created_by, status, scope)?
Benji Okafor (author): Added from/to metadata blocks to diff response (same fields as list items). This keeps the diff endpoint self-contained. Updated OpenAPI examples accordingly.
Felix Schneider: Diff output is a little noisy when a field is omitted vs explicitly set to default. Can we canonicalize defaults before diffing so the UI doesn't highlight non-changes?
Benji Okafor (author): Implemented canonicalization using the schema defaulting logic (same as validation path) before diff. Added tests for omitted->default equivalence.
Marcus Lin: Please ensure request logging does not include the full config payload (may include customer-specific routing hints later). Also confirm error messages don’t leak internal IDs.

Benji Okafor (author): Logging now includes version_id/config_id and scope only; payload is redacted. Error messages return ocv_* and config_id only, not numeric DB IDs. Added a negative test for 404/403 body.
Ethan Park: Looks good after the cursor change + serializer split. Approved.
Chloe Martin: Approved — meets Console requirements. Thank you for adding metadata to diff response.
Marcus Lin: Approved with note: revisit ETag/caching once Console wires this to reduce control-plane read load.
release_notes: New read-only APIs for Optimization Config version history and diffs (RBAC-gated) to support Console change history and safe apply workflows.
